newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Duma to discuss 1997 draft budget on Dec 6.
newsitem.headline: Russia Duma to discuss 1997 draft budget on Dec 6.

text.p: The Russian State Duma lower house of parliament will discuss the 1997 draft budget in the first reading on Friday, December 6, first deputy speker Alexander Shokhin said on Tuesday.
The Duma wil discuss amendments to tax laws relevant to the budget on Wednesday, a Duma spokesman said.
Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin will present the budget to the Duma on December 6.
The Duma rejected the original draft budget in October with deputies criticising it for unrealistic revenue projections and inadequate spending.
The government and parliament then set up a reconciliation commission, which in November agreed a new draft to be debated by the Duma.
The new draft calls for a deficit of 95.40 trillion roubles, or 3.5 percent of gross domestic product.
